title.rendered: The Horus Heresy – Maelstrom of War – November 21st 2026

content.rendered:
Horus Heresy – Maelstrom of War – November 21st 2026

Do you like fun and want to hang out with some kewl wargamers? The answer is yes. You are kewl. You are fun. Come down to Hightide and play some chill games with your friends.

EVENT ESSENTIALS

→ Location: Hightide (3 Josephson St, Fremantle)

→ Time: 09:00am to 06:30pm

→ Ticket: $45

→ Structure: 2500 points; 3 rounds with bespoke missions

→ Prizing: Awards for generalship, painting, sportsmanship, and best overall

→ Registration: No pre-registration is required.

Legacy members: Buy your ticket in store to get your $10 discount.

SCHEDULE

→ 09:00am: Registration

→ 09:30am: Round 1

→ 12:10am: Lunch and painting competition

→ 01:10pm: Round 2

→ 03:50pm: Round 3

→ 06:30pm: Awards

ARMY CONSTRUCTION

To play at this event you must have a 2500 point Warhammer: The Horus Heresy army. Players may use any Liber, Journal Tactica, or Legacies of the Age of Darkness to construct their army. In addition to the normal rules players may not use the Warlord or Lords of War detachments. Players may also select one of the following Prime Advantages if they wish:

→ Unorthodox Tactician: May only be selected by a unit with Command sub-type. All units in a single auxiliary detachment in this character’s army may given the Line (1) or Vanguard (1) special rule.

→ Lord Executioner: This unit gains the Honour or Death (2) special rule. Honour or Death (x): this model gains victory points for winning challenges, or for enemies declining them. The amount of victory points gained is equal to the value of x.

→ Master of Logistics: May only be selected by a model with the Command sub-type. Once per game this army may attempt to deep strike one additional unit, or reroll a single failed reserves roll.

MISSIONS

Each table will have a bespoke mission and thematic terrain. Instead of the usual swiss pairings, there will be a three game round robin; each player will play on three different tables, against three different opponents. The missions will be revealed on the day and there will be extra time between rounds for players to read each mission.

MODELLING REQUIRMENTS

All miniatures must be fully assembled and painted to a battle ready standard. This means all areas of the miniature must be painted and details be picked out with appropriate colours. Proxies and conversions/kitbashes are allowed at the tournament organiser’s discretion. If you intend to use any proxies or converted/kitbashed miniatures please contact us before the event.

GLORIOUS VICTORY AND FABULOUS PRIZES

This event will be scored using the following three criteria:

→ Generalship

→ Painting

→ Sportsmanship

Players will earn points in each of these three categories by winning games, and getting peer voted painting and sportsmanship scores. There will also be an award for overall hobby which will comprise of the combined generalship, painting, and sportsmanship scores. Each winner will have the opportunity to select a prize from a prize table.

content.rendered:
Warhammer: The Old World – Death on the Reik – November 14th 2026

Death on the Reik is a single-day event for Warhammer: The Old World. Imagine you are a simple fisherman sailing up the Reik – and then BAM you are attacked and viciously murdered by a beast-mutant-thing. Come down and crush your enemies, then play some Warhammer.

EVENT ESSENTIALS

→ Location: Hightide (3 Josephson St, Fremantle)

→ Time: 09:00am to 06:00pm

→ Ticket: $45

→ Structure: 2000 points – 3 Randomised matched play scenarios

→ Prizing: Awards for generalship, painting, sportsmanship, and best overall

→ Registration: You will also need to sign-up via BCP before the event: https://www.bestcoastpairings.com/event/2hThs0lXhM2t

Legacy members: Buy your ticket in store to get your $10 discount.

SCHEDULE

→ 09:00am: Registration

→ 09:30am: Round 1

→ 12:00am: Lunch & Painting Competition

→ 01:00pm: Round 2

→ 03:30pm: Round 3

→ 06:00pm: Awards

ARMY CONSTRUCTION

To play at this event you must have an army of no more than 2000 points. Details on choosing your army can be found on pages 276-283 of the Warhammer: The Old World Rulebook. Your army must adhere to the Grand Melee and Combined Arms army rules found on page 13 of the Matched Play Guide. When building your army please use the most up to date rules found in the following publications:

→ Warhammer: The Old World – Forces of Fantasy

→ Warhammer: The Old World – Ravening Hordes

→ Arcane Journals

→ Legend PDFs

→ All up-to-date FAQs and Errata. Publications released up to one week before the event may also be used at this event

Army lists should be presented in a format that’s easy to read. Please ensure you record your General, Lore(s) of Magic, Magic items, and all relevant weapon selections and unit upgrades that should be selected before a game begins.

SCENARIOS

You will play three of the six Matched Play Scenarios found on pages 20-25 of the Matched Play Guide. These scenarios will be randomly drawn at the beginning of the event. At this event, the Fixed Turn Limit and Time Limit game length rules are in effect. Secondary Objectives will only be used if a Scenario states they must be.

MODELLING REQUIRMENTS

All miniatures must be fully assembled and painted to a battle ready standard. This means all areas of the miniature must be painted and details be picked out with appropriate colours. Proxies and conversions/kitbashes are allowed at the tournament organiser’s discretion. If you intend to use any proxies or converted/kitbashed miniatures please contact us before the event.

GLORIOUS VICTORY AND FABULOUS PRIZES

This event will be scored using the following three criteria:

→ Generalship

→ Painting

→ Sportsmanship

Players will earn points in each of these three categories by winning games, and getting peer voted painting and sportsmanship scores. There will also be an award for overall hobby which will comprise of the combined generalship, painting, and sportsmanship scores. Each winner will have the opportunity to select a prize from a prize table.

Legacy Members: Buy your ticket in store to get your $10 discount.

SCHEDULE

→ 08:30am: Round 1

→ 11:30am: Lunch & Painting Competition

→ 12:30pm: Round 2

→ 03:30pm: Round 3

→ 06:30pm: Awards

ARMY & DETACHMENT SELECTION

Join us at Hightide for the final tournament of the WA Kill Team Circuit's first-ever circuit.

If you're hearing the word "tournament" and thinking "That's not for me," we want to assure you that this is a chill-AF event, perfect for newbies and veterans alike. Overall, the circuit is about rolling dice, having a laugh, and leering at cool minis. So come on down, equip yourself with a white Monster, and be amongst your people.
